mechanics.name: Earthquake
mechanics.note: Shakes everyone near him; ranged taking it were inside a radius they never had to be in.

mechanics.name: Magma Splash
mechanics.note: Stacks on everyone who melees him, shredding armour as it goes. The fight's damage, not anybody's mistake. Four spells in the client share this name; this is the one Forever retuned for the 40-player raid, which is how it was picked.

mechanics.name: Mangle
mechanics.note: The Core Ragers' bleed on whoever is holding them. Tank damage.
